film.lumiere_train.title: The Arrival of a Train at La Ciotat
film.lumiere_train.l1: Look: the station of a little town by the sea. The engine will appear in a moment.
film.lumiere_train.l2: They say people jumped from their seats at the first showing. Sit still: it will stop.
film.lumiere_train.l3: The lady in white looks for someone. None of these people knew they'd be watched a hundred and thirty years later.
film.lumiere_factory.title: Workers Leaving the Lumière Factory in Lyon
film.lumiere_factory.l1: This is the very first film in the world. Lunch break, and the factory gates open.
film.lumiere_factory.l2: A cyclist, a dog, hats. Just like our people coming off a shift at the Cog.
film.lumiere_sprinkler.title: The Sprinkler Sprinkled
film.lumiere_sprinkler.l1: The first film comedy. A gardener waters the beds, and behind him is a boy.
film.lumiere_sprinkler.l2: The boy has stepped on the hose. Now watch…
film.lumiere_sprinkler.l3: Caught him! A hundred and thirty years on, and boys are just the same.
film.lumiere_baby.title: Baby's Meal
film.lumiere_baby.l1: Auguste Lumière and his wife feed their little daughter. The first home movie.
film.lumiere_baby.l2: Look at the leaves behind them: the wind. Back then people marvelled at the leaves more than at the people.
film.cohl_fantasmagorie.title: Fantasmagorie
film.cohl_fantasmagorie.l1: The first drawn cartoon. Chalk on a blackboard, and the artist's hand.
film.cohl_fantasmagorie.l2: The little man turns into anything: a bottle, a flower, an elephant. Try to keep up.
film.melies_rubber_head.title: The Man with the Rubber Head
film.melies_rubber_head.l1: Méliès was a stage magician, and film became his best trick. A scientist in his laboratory…
film.melies_rubber_head.l2: …inflates his own head with a pair of bellows! Don't try it at home.
film.melies_rubber_head.l3: The assistant, of course, overdoes it.
film.melies_moon.title: A Trip to the Moon
film.melies_moon.l1: The scientists meet in council: Professor Barbenfouillis proposes a trip to the Moon.
film.melies_moon.l2: They build the shell on a rooftop and cast the cannon. As in Jules Verne: the book is in our library.
film.melies_moon.l3: Right in the eye! The whole world knows this shot.
film.melies_moon.l4: Stars peer out of the clouds. And on the Moon live the Selenites, who are not glad of guests.
film.melies_moon.l5: To get back they simply fall off the edge of the Moon. Into the sea. Almost like here.
film.chomon_hotel.title: The Electric Hotel
film.chomon_hotel.l1: A couple arrive at a hotel where electricity does everything. The suitcases unpack themselves.
film.chomon_hotel.l2: The comb combs by itself, the boots polish themselves. Chomón shot it frame by frame: hundreds of hours.
film.chomon_hotel.l3: And then a drunk electrician in the machine room… well, you can see.
film.porter_robbery.title: The Great Train Robbery
film.porter_robbery.l1: The first western. Bandits tie up the telegraph operator at the station.
film.porter_robbery.l2: A fight on the roof of the car. That's a dummy instead of a man, of course: look closely.
film.porter_robbery.l3: A girl finds the tied-up operator, and there's dancing in the saloon. The chase!
film.porter_robbery.l4: And in those days this shot went at the beginning or the end, as the projectionist liked.
